posts.text:
The truth is all marketing now is just code and tokens.

So learning to market these days means learning to set up an agent with your data, creative tools and ad accounts.

Set it up right and you get a top 0.1% marketer testing an absurd number of ideas every day: https://t.co/64vZyolTFP https://t.co/pyXGW79Qrh
posts.text_zh:
真相是，现在所有营销都只是代码和 tokens。

所以现如今学习营销，意味着学会用你的数据、创意工具和广告账户来搭建一个 agent。

搭对了，你就相当于拥有一个顶尖 0.1% 的营销人，每天都能测试海量想法： https://t.co/64vZyolTFP https://t.co/pyXGW79Qrh

引用内容：他引用了自己稍早的帖子：learn to market is the new learn to code（学习营销就是新的学习编程）。
